figurative_meaning_en: unadulterated, complete (as in a pure or outright falsehood)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা ডাহা মিথ্যা, কেউ বিশ্বাস করবে না।
রাজনীতিতে ডাহা মিথ্যা বলাটা সাধারণ ব্যাপার।
example_sentences_in_english: His statement was a bald-faced lie; no one will believe it.
In politics, telling outright lies has become commonplace.
note: Commonly used to describe obvious falsehoods without any attempt at subtlety
